# ClinicFlow

> ClinicFlow is a multi-tenant clinic appointment booking platform. Patients browse clinics and doctors and book appointments online; clinics manage schedules, doctors, treatments, and enquiries.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Find a clinic and book an appointment.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How patient and clinic data is handled.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Terms governing use of ClinicFlow.
